auth_details: No authentication required for public scan and result endpoints.
rate_limits: One new scan per host per minute; cached results may be returned during the cooldown.
description: Mozilla Observatory (MDN HTTP Observatory) analyzes websites for HTTP security best practices and related web-hardening signals, focusing on security headers and configuration checks. Developers use its API to scan sites, retrieve grade/score results, and track security posture over time. It does not provide TLS/certificate analysis (that capability was part of the former multi-tool Observatory sunset in 2024).
resolution_notes: rate_limits: auditor correct — official API docs document one scan per host per minute with cached results during cooldown (https://github.com/mdn/mdn-http-observatory/blob/main/src/api/v2/README.md). description: auditor correct — current MDN HTTP Observatory is header/hardening focused; TLS analysis was part of the sunset multi-tool Observatory (https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/observatory, https://github.com/mdn/mdn-http-observatory).
